items.title: Draft Colliery Control (Amendment) Rules, 2026
items.note: Would make the Coal Controller the competent authority on mining-plan compliance, let it suspend all or part of a mine's operations that depart from the approved mining plan (after a rectification direction and a 15-day show-cause notice, or at once where safety, the environment or imminent harm require), and require each company Board to declare annually that mining followed the approved plan and all applicable laws. The 30-day comment window, from the Gazette's public release on 13 October 2026, closed on 12 November 2026; the final rules have not been notified, so this is not in force.

items.title: Colliery Control — penalty rule
items.note: The Colliery Control (Second Amendment) Rules, 2026, in force on publication, substitute rule 13: contraventions now attract a penalty under sections 25A and 25B of the MMDR Act and the Mines and Minerals Adjudication of Penalties Rules, 2026 made under them.

items.title: Draft OSH&WC (Coal Mines) Regulations, 2026
items.note: Proposed successor to CMR 2017, made under the OSH&WC Code 2020 (s.136). The 45-day consultation window closed in March 2026 and no final notification has issued since, so the draft remains pending. CMR 2017 stays fully operative until it does.

items.title: Mining Plan & Mine Closure Guidelines, 2026
items.note: On 31 July 2026 the Ministry of Coal invited written comments, within 15 days, on redrafted mining plan and mine closure guidelines. That window has closed, and no final guidelines had been issued as of 10 November 2026. MPG-2025 therefore remains in force; if the 2026 guidelines are notified they would supersede it, with plans uploaded before commencement staying under the 2025 regime.

items.title: The four Labour Codes — rollout
items.note: Wages, Industrial Relations, Social Security and OSH&WC Codes brought into force; the (Central) Rules, 2026 were finalised 8 May 2026. Jharkhand published draft Code on Wages and OSH&WC rules in 2021; its final state rules have not yet been notified.

items.title: NCWA-XII wage settlement
items.note: The Eleventh National Coal Wage Agreement, signed 20 May 2023, covered 1 July 2021 to 30 June 2026 and has now expired. The Twelfth has not been signed. JBCCI-XII — the joint bipartite committee that negotiates it — is still not constituted. At the Apex Joint Consultative Committee meeting on 3 September 2026 the central trade unions sought an exemption from Section 14 of the Industrial Relations Code, 2020, which governs how negotiating unions and councils are recognised, and Coal India management agreed to take it to the Coal Ministry. Coal India was reported on 2 October to have written to the Ministry seeking that exemption. The Ministry's decision is pending, and nothing has issued to report.

items.title: CMR 2017 — Assistant Manager scale
items.note: Notification under regulation 30 of CMR 2017 fixing the scale of appointment of Assistant Managers in coal mines; it replaces G.S.R. 427(E).

items.title: Forest clearance — Van Rules 2023
items.note: The Van (Sanrakshan Evam Samvardhan) Rules, 2023 replaced the Forest (Conservation) Rules, 2022. They have since been amended, including by G.S.R. 877(E) of 29 November 2025 and G.S.R. 174(E) of 11 March 2026; the library holds the 2023 text.
